item: Trail-bundle verify reads only a ZIP upload: 415 for any other Content-Type (R315 option 1, OPEN_QUEUE item 14)
summary: R319 release note: POST /api/claims/trail-bundle/verify now answers 415 to any Content-Type other than application/zip or application/octet-stream, and to a POST with none, before it reads the body. The three types a browser sends cross-site without a preflight (text/plain, form-urlencoded, multipart) no longer reach the ZIP parser; before, they answered 200 not_zip. The Claim tab already sends application/zip, so nothing changes for it; a script posting a bundle must name one of the two types.
